text:
BREAKING: The NYT's new AI columnist was paid by an Anthropic investor while she wrote about the company, with no disclosure, per ZeroHedge.

Jasmine Sun, hired by NYT Opinion on Nov. 17, was paid about $50,000 as an Omidyar Network "Reporter in Residence" from January to July. Omidyar has owned Anthropic shares since 2024, a stake Forbes valued at more than $55 million at the IPO. During the residency, Sun wrote about Anthropic's Pentagon fight and called her work "fully independent journalism."

Her NYT essay on Anthropic employees ran the day after the IPO priced, with no mention of Omidyar. Neither Sun nor the NYT has commented.
